info.title: Relay API
info.description: Relay's REST API: conversations, contacts, tickets, articles and knowledge, macros, workflows, outbound, events, attributes, segments, search and export. Authenticate with a personal access token (Settings › Developers) as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Name a version with `Relay-Version`; without one, the token's own version is used.
